draft.answer: Yes. Multi-factor authentication is required for all employee accounts through our identity provider.
draft.note: This uses the approved answer LIB-MFA-01 (approved 2026-09-01) word for word. It covers employee accounts that go through the identity provider. It doesn't mention contractors, service accounts or systems outside the identity provider, so check with the security team if the customer asks about those.
